svg.title: Twelve recovered boron cluster templates
svg.desc: Actual recovered atomic coordinates projected into separate panels. Seven twelve-site templates have icosahedral graphs. Other templates have fourteen, twenty-eight and twenty-nine sites.

g.text: Geometry-only cluster proposals · six boron models
No preferred motif size or polyhedron was supplied to the discovery algorithm.
Each panel is independently rescaled. Lines are geometric graph edges, not assigned chemical bonds.
Coordinates: An et al. (2016), supplementary CIF models. Finite proposals only; bridging pairs are not shown.
